title: Equipment slots
notes: Seven boxes, read off the Charactersheet layout in sheet order. Names keep the sheet's casing and spelling ("accesory").
The sheet gives no slot a count or an accepts-list — every box holds one "material material object" string. Concept 10's count/accepts fields are a later milestone.

The grid and the placements are the sheet's own arrangement, not an invention: columns M/N/O are 1/2/3 and rows 3/7/11/14 are 1/2/3/4, so the range is exactly a 3×4 board with five of its twelve cells empty. Column 1 rows 1, 3 and 4 and column 3 rows 1 and 4 are blank on the sheet and are blank here.

Glyphs have no source in the spreadsheet — it draws no pictures, only labelled boxes. Each is the app's own reading of what the box holds, chosen from the set in `types/config.ts`, and is display-only: nothing derives from it.
